description.en: Reserves the lightning-bolt training minigame of the given type to start after the current script finishes.
Type of training minigame to start.

Likely true once the training minigame was reserved; null if the call was invalid (no training type given). The success value is produced by an internal reservation helper that wasn't fully traceable from the decompiled code.

example.code:
// Reserve a training minigame of a given type
CMND_RESERVE_TRAINING(traType);
